DECISION GUIDANCE
Reference spike: check cache_reset/fresh/function_calls versus source_loop_ms.
Memory spike: check four disjoint stages; unchanged IDs with long time needs further CPU/scheduler instrumentation.
Geometry spike: check broad/support/exact and body/cable query count.
RHS/rejected numbers diagnose native numerical workload, not MATLAB pauses.
An unsensed obstacle is never added by the trigger.
No sampled-only no-contact can certify continuous-time safety.
